record.paper_title: Open Problems: The Spectrum of the Hilbert Matrix as an Operator on ℓ^p
record.context_brief: Spectrum of generalized Hilbert matrices on ℓ^p
record.original_question: For a complex parameter λ ∈ C \ {-1, -2, -3, ...}, let H_λ be the infinite matrix with entries a_{mn} = (m + n + 1 - λ)^(-1) for m, n = 0, 1, 2, .... When H_λ is viewed as an operator on ℓ^p for 2 < p < ∞, determine its full spectrum, its point spectrum, and its essential spectrum. In particular, for real λ < 1, is the spectrum exactly {π sec(πu) : |Re u| ≤ 1/2 - 1/p}, with interior equal to the point spectrum and boundary equal to the essential spectrum?

evidence.quote: Given a complex number λ ∈ C \ {−1, −2, −3,...}, we consider the matrix H_λ with coefficients a_mn = (m + n + 1 − λ)^−1, m, n = 0, 1, 2,...
Problem. Determine the spectrum, the point spectrum and the essential spectrum of H_λ as an operator on ℓ^p for 2 < p < ∞.
Conjecture. For λ < 1, the set {π sec πu : |Re u| ≤ 1/2−1/p} is the spectrum, the interior of this set is the point spectrum, and its boundary is the essential spectrum.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a complex parameter $\lambda \in \mathbb{C} \setminus \{-1, -2, -3, \ldots\}$, define the infinite matrix $H_\lambda = (a_{mn})_{m,n=0}^\infty$ with entries
$$a_{mn} = \frac{1}{m + n + 1 - \lambda}, \qquad m, n = 0, 1, 2, \ldots.$$
Assume that, for the values of $\lambda$ and $p$ considered, $H_\lambda$ defines a bounded linear operator on the sequence space $\ell^p$ (for $1 \le p < \infty$, $\ell^p$ is the Banach space of complex sequences $(x_n)_{n \ge 0}$ with $\sum_n |x_n|^p < \infty$).

Fix $p$ with $2 < p < \infty$. Determine, for each admissible $\lambda$:
(a) the spectrum $\sigma(H_\lambda)$ of $H_\lambda$ acting on $\ell^p$;
(b) the point spectrum $\sigma_p(H_\lambda)$ (the set of eigenvalues);
(c) the essential spectrum $\sigma_e(H_\lambda)$.

In particular, decide whether the following conjecture holds: for every real $\lambda < 1$,
$$\sigma(H_\lambda) = \left\{\, \pi \sec(\pi u) : u \in \mathbb{C},\ |\operatorname{Re} u| \le \tfrac{1}{2} - \tfrac{1}{p}\,\right\},$$
the point spectrum $\sigma_p(H_\lambda)$ equals the interior of this set, and the essential spectrum $\sigma_e(H_\lambda)$ equals its boundary.
artifact.category_tag: Spectral theory of Hilbert matrix operators
artifact.status_search_result: A 2024 survey on the Hilbert matrix operator and a 2021 paper "On the Spectrum of the Hilbert Matrix Operator" discuss partial results: the spectrum on $\ell^2$ (Magnus), latent roots via Rosenblum–Hill, and point-spectrum descriptions on Hardy spaces. However, no source verifies the full spectrum/point spectrum/essential spectrum description of $H_\lambda$ on $\ell^p$ for $2<p<\infty$, and the conjectured set $\{\pi\sec(\pi u):|\operatorname{Re} u|\le 1/2-1/p\}$ for real $\lambda<1$ does not appear to have been confirmed. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the Hilbert matrix operator: a brief survey
status_evidence.snippet: Section 6 'Spectral properties' surveys results on H_lambda; spectral details on ℓ^p for the parameterized operator are not fully resolved.
status_evidence.claim: Recent survey indicates spectral description on ℓ^p is incomplete for the generalized Hilbert matrix.

status_evidence.title: On the Spectrum of Hilbert Matrix Operator
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses point spectrum on Hardy spaces and latent roots π/sin(πμ); essential spectrum on ℓ^p remains under investigation.
status_evidence.claim: Existing literature gives only partial spectral information; the full spectrum on ℓ^p (p>2) is not established.
